text: Eight Sleep is a sleep-technology company whose flagship product, the Pod, combines dynamic temperature regulation, biometric tracking, and AI-powered intelligence to unlock deeper sleep and recovery; it is trusted by elite athletes and high-performing professionals.
short: Eight Sleep is a sleep-technology company; its flagship product is the Pod.
